releaseNotes:
1. Professional Guided Installer: Live 7-step visual checklist with progress bars, eliminating silent installs and premature browser launch.
2. Native Desktop POS Window: Runs completely headless without terminal windows, localhost URLs, or browser address bars.
3. Automatic Two-Way Cloud Sync: Instant live syncing between Cloud Manager (pospro.plannestapp.com) and local POS terminal.
4. Hardware Setup: RS-232 Digital Scale with baud configuration & auto-read to cart, and Windows installed receipt printer selector.
5. Complete Store Data Isolation: Fixed shop identity and separate catalog per store.
